title: Dynamic Tab Services Counter Fix
desc: Fixed the services tab counter so each tab displays its own specific item count (e.g., 1/4 or 1/5) rather than the global total count across all categories, ensuring accurate navigation numbers.

title: DineDraft Live Platform Link Integration
desc: Integrated the verified live URL (https://dinedraft.com/) into the DineDraft portfolio showcase, production shipments monitor, and case study cards so visitors can directly test and view the platform live.

title: Architecture of Dedicated Project Case Studies System
desc: Architected an elevated case study system featuring dedicated project pages, multi-image screenshot galleries, challenge and solution breakdowns, KPI metrics ribbons, and live platform redirection links.

title: Centralized Project Data Repository
desc: Built a single-source-of-truth project repository (projects-data.php) containing structured metadata, tech stacks, performance metrics, client profiles, and gallery assets for all flagship applications.

title: Category Filter Pill Contrast & Styling Fix
desc: Resolved an active state styling bug where selected category filter pills had invisible white text on transparent backgrounds. Defined missing CSS variables and reinforced active contrast styling.

title: Case Study Clean URL & Parameter Routing Fix
desc: Fixed clean URL redirect logic in header.php that previously stripped query strings and caused every project card to open DineDraft. Added support for clean /project/{slug} routing without data loss.

title: Portfolio Card Redesign & Compact Layout
desc: Restyled portfolio project cards into a compact modern format by adjusting media aspect ratios to 16:9, tightening card padding, clamping descriptions, and optimizing badge sizing for clean UI.

title: Mobile Horizontal Swipe Carousel Implementation
desc: Enabled a horizontal swipe carousel for mobile devices with CSS scroll-snap, peek preview widths, a custom branded scrollbar, and visual swipe hints, ensuring smooth touchscreen navigation.

title: Side-by-Side Gallery Showcase Redesign
desc: Re-architected the case study page layout by positioning the thumbnail image gallery to the right side of the main preview screen, optimizing viewport hierarchy and eliminating excessive scrolling.

title: Gallery Card Whitespace & Gap Tightening
desc: Eliminated awkward vertical gaps between gallery thumbnail cards by replacing space-between flex alignment with a compact 10px spacing, enabling instant one-click switching of main preview images.

title: Flagship Project Integration: Pehle Pakistan
desc: Added the 'Pehle Pakistan' national news platform (pehlepakistan.pk) as a flagship project, incorporating high-res mockups, 3.2M+ pageview metrics, editorial CMS specs, and verified live platform links.

title: Media & Publishing Category Filter Addition
desc: Introduced a new 'Media & Publishing' category filter pill to the portfolio grid with dedicated green status accents, incrementing the total project counter to 06 and enabling instant category filtering.

title: Production Shipments Console Live Monitor Update
desc: Updated the cyber console monitor on the portfolio hero section to track 6 live production systems, featuring Pehle Pakistan with real-time green uptime indicators and direct external visit links.

title: Static HTML & PHP Template Synchronization
desc: Synchronized dynamic PHP project pages and portfolio components into static HTML files (portfolio.html and project-details.html), ensuring seamless client-side viewing and deployment consistency.

title: Homepage PHP Syntax Error & Routing Resolution
desc: Resolved an unclosed curly brace syntax error in index.php that caused a line 70 parse error. Restored full functionality to the homepage and route handlers across local and production web servers.
